task:
Work with taints and tolerations:

  1. Taint a node of your choice with:
     - key: gpu
     - value: true
     - effect: NoSchedule

  2. Create a Pod named 'gpu-pod' in namespace 'default' that:
     - Image: nginx:1.21
     - Has a toleration for the taint: gpu=true:NoSchedule
     - Verify the pod schedules successfully

  3. Create a Pod named 'no-toleration-pod' with image nginx:1.21
     - No toleration
     - If it's the only tainted node in a single-node cluster, it will be Pending

Note: In a single-node cluster the control plane IS the only node, so taint it
with 'kubectl taint nodes <node-name> gpu=true:NoSchedule' and remove it after
with 'kubectl taint nodes <node-name> gpu=true:NoSchedule-'
hints: Toleration in pod spec: {key: gpu, operator: Equal, value: 'true', effect: NoSchedule}
kubectl taint nodes <node-name> gpu=true:NoSchedule-  (trailing dash removes the taint)
detailed_hints: Get node name: kubectl get nodes --no-headers -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name | head -1
Verify taint: kubectl describe node <node> | grep Taints
Pod toleration spec: tolerations: [{key: gpu, operator: Equal, value: 'true', effect: NoSchedule}]
